Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): a121cb1824643aaf
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
mem_la_addr low bits are stuck at 2'b10 instead of 2'b00, so every lookahead fetch/data address is misaligned. Trace shows TRAP: fetch misalign addr low bits nonzero with tohost FAIL 0xdead. Root cause is line 382 forcing {..,2'b10} on both fetch and data paths instead of word-aligned {..,2'b00}.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash a121cb1824643aaf in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
